reviews.text:
The receptionists, veterinarian and vet assistants here are so kind. Today we had Andres, in the past we had good experiences with other vet techs as well.
You can tell they all care for animals so much and really try to make your babies feel comfortable. And of course affordable- I was looking at an old vet bill where my dog got a heart worm test, cephalexin & flea and tick prevention & this bill from north line is $304 cheaper!!!

I brought in my 12 week old cat he was diagnosed with an ear infection I was given drops and sent home.  Came back a week later with concerns the infection hadn’t cleared they let me know one ear was still infected I mentioned prescribing steroids/antibiotics the DR said it wasn’t needed it should clear on its own come back in two weeks. He didn’t even bother to look in the cat’s ear just swabbed it. The cat progressively got worse over the next few days I had to put him down because the infection traveled to his brain and he lost his vision and ability to stand on his own. This all could have been avoided if they prioritized actually examining the patient’s thoroughly instead of focusing on getting you out of there quickly due to it being packed. I do not recommend this place spend the extra money and take your pet somewhere that actually care for the patients.
I did  a walk in appt (Walked in at 10 am and walked out by 12). Friendly staff. Doctor was attentive and provided me with medication for my sick dog. She is feeling much better !

I've had the absolute pleasure being a client of Affordable Pet Clinic going on almost 8 years with 4 pets that includes my recently IPO titled 3 year old GSD. The lead Doctor has to be the most seasoned of veterinarians I've chosen to care for my pets. Logical, practical & isn't attempting to over charge with the "unnecessarise" & BS. Lowest prices on prevention treatments. Kind genuinely caring techs & staff. Efficient. I won't go anywhere else. Don't let the outside appearance discourage choice- it's the level of decades experience, trust & doing "right" on the inside is all that should mater & final outcome of a healthy & happy pet. Thank you & God bless Affordable Pet Clinic!

We came as a walkin to have a beloved stray put down as his health had deteriorated. The front staff were very warm and welcoming. It seemed super busy for a Friday morning but they allowed us to wait in our car and called us in when it was his time to be seen. The vet, as well as the assistants, seemed very well educated, kind and supportive. They all were very caring and not at all cold like most vets I’ve seen. The building is far from fancy but the care you and your pet receives here is superior to any vet office and it didn’t smell bad like some places do. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a great vet with attentive and kind staff. Brownie points for the affordable care! ❤️ Thank you for serving our community!
Teresa and dr. Challa and all the staff are great. The wait is long so get here early. Once you are inside in attendance they will take good care of you. Treatment and pricing are very affordable.
Great service.
Very much Nices Doctors  and  Nurses
Very efficient and affordable. Will be coming back for future dental cleaning visits!!  No more periodontal disease, thanks to the doctors and assistants!

Had to take my dog to the vet after a terrible accident and the way they treat my dog was so compassionate.
The vet was honest and direct, helpful through a really hard and sad time. Before leaving the place one of the vets, stopped me to hand me over a little jar filled with fur of my now, at that point, deceased dog.
She didnt had to do that, and at that moment that gesture was so genuine and emphatic that surely is gonna stay in my mind every time I will remembered this experience with my dog.
I totally recommend this vet clinic. They are wonderful and caring.
Exceptional staff and doctors
Nurse Teresa provided excellent care, and I really enjoyed Dr. Satya's explanation. 🙏🏼🙏🏼🙏🏼🙏🏼🥰🥰🫂 …
Great place
The veterinarian is very good and professional. He lovingly attended to my 95-pout Chiquita, my beautiful little furry girl.
Excellent service
Staff is totally incompetent and needs to be fired
They are amazing with the animals and prices are affordable
The vet service was quick, efficient, and effective.
Great customer service! They really care about the pets
Great atmosphere, pet friendly 👌, the only thing is the waiter want to take your plate right away but overall great place yo eat great food 👍
The Vets love animals here. Much love and respect from this dog lover.
Well organized Veterinarian clinic offering essential treatments for pets in Houston.

Do NOT come to this clinic. I had came to confirm if my dog had passed or if he was still here. When telling the receptionist, she had a stupid smirk on her face and seemed very happy telling us they had their last walk in at 4:22pm and cannot help us. You guys close at 5:30?? We came in at 4:25pm i believe, Tuesday July 14th. The receptionist lady was super disrespectful not just towards my dog but towards us. Do better and have at least some sympathy.
Dog vaccines.
They were very helpful with my dog and very very affordable with the cost,thanks!!
I love this place! The friendly staff and process help me to keep my dogs up to date with health care

I brought my two dogs in today, and Dr. Satya was wonderful. He took the time to answer all of my questions and addressed every concern I had without making me feel rushed. He performed a thorough assessment and provided attentive, compassionate care.

Liz, the assistant, was also amazing with both of my dogs, they seemed to like her. She was kind and patient throughout the visit.

The front desk staff could be a bit more welcoming and attentive, but overall, the excellent care provided by Dr. Satya and Liz made for a great experience. I truly appreciate the time and attention they gave my pets.
He's a good doctor, it's just that the woman in front of him, named Marisol, has a very unfriendly attitude and way of answering.
Quick affordable and polite. Was pretty busy and still took me as a walk in.

My cat was attacked by a dog, but seemed to only have minor exterior injuries. She was lethargic so I took her to the vet. She had x-rays taken and it showed she had a puncture lung, but no other internal wounds, at least that's what I was told. The vet told me the lung would heal on its own and to just keep an eye on her and take her to the ER if needed. I took her the very next day and she did not make it. The ER informed me her injuries were very extensive and way worse than what the vet at this clinic told me. Don't take your pets here. Far too busy to pay proper attention to your pet and I wouldn't want someone else to lose their best friend.
My family and I have been taking our pet there for a couple of years. The staff is always kind and loving towards our Cats and the prices our so affordable. We are so thankful for them
Good experience at the clinic. Good prices and friendly staff. Great care to my kitten and doctor addressed all my concerns.

Took my cat to be seen for dental infection. Told them she has tooth pain & talked about possible extraction. I wait an hour and a half in the car to be seen only to be told they don’t do any dental procedures- no extractions, no cleaning, etc. I paid for an office visit and left with a list of local vets to call for an appointment for dental care! What a waste. And very traumatizing to put my kitty through another appointment while she’s suffering.
I went to this location specifically because it advertises right here on their list of services that they offer: “dental exam, cleaning, and polishing”, “oral health”, “pet dental health”, “pets teeth”, etc. see listed services right here on google where they listed these.
Then I went to their website. Same thing- they listed these the very services that they told me they don’t offer.

I’ve taken my dog here since a baby, they treated me wonderfully in the begging.ive been going here for 4yrs I never once had an issue booking an appointment or anything. These past few months I’ve started to noticed all the nurses and even the doctor had an opinion about me. You can feel the energy When they don’t want to deal with you. Besides that they purposely don’t pick up the phone, yu have to call and call for them to actually answer,mind you I spend THOUSANDS OF DOLLARS HERE!!yes,I expect the best service.i called couple week ago NO APPOINTMENTS WERE AVAILABLE,So I Did A Walk In , walk in are around (1hr-2hr). Last time I did a walk in I waited&waited I only need my dog to get his Allergy injection,I asked them how much longer they type of dog I have he can’t be in hot for too long,anyways THE LADY IN THE FRONT WAS visibly annoyed with me and you can tell she did not want to deal with me all because I asked how much longer is it going to take all I need was an injection for my dog. She proceeds to tell me next time. Make sure you book an appointment I proceed to tell her I tried to, but you never pick up the phone. She rolled her eyes and ignored me and guess what all of a sudden there’s an appointment available. I used to love this clinic for my dog. I called this morning to book an appointment. They did not answer. I called three times they finally Answered, I explained my issue to them at this point, they know who I am and they know my dog every time I walked in. I will hear the vets talk about each other. Oh no here comes this dog. Oh no, I know about this dog. Oh, I heard about this dog if you’re going to work at a establishment make sure you love animals deeply. I spent thousands of dollars in this damn clinic for them to disrespect me to hang up in my face this morning and to have me wait months and weeks just to get a freaking appointment and then they wanna tell me I can just walk in when I have to wait an hour or two hours take your money somewhere else. I chose to ignore them and I really hope this review gets people’s attention I have all my paperwork from them. I have every single name that helped me with my dog. I spent thousands of dollars When I call, I don’t expect no attitude. I don’t expect y’all to hang up on me for me to call again and y’all get annoyed.
It's best to make an appointment

The office staff is horrible...I went to ask for corporate phone number and the community manager told me to goggle it..I have been getting noise complaints the whole month of May and today June 2,2026 mine you I stay alone with 2pets I have no TV or radio no company but I keep getting these awful threats about further action if it continues.. The apartment overall is nice..Kool neighbors.. maintenance Is awesome.. The Apartment is just too hollow I hear everything conversation.. fighting...dogs barking.. babies crying but I'm not complaining about it because you can help but tho hear it the walls and flooring are paper thin..I had Help moving here as I am disabled they knew about my help and because the check was a day late I had an eviction the same month I got here lol they recalled it but didn't not give me the court fees back at all.. I moved here to Start Over not to disrupt nobody..not to be threatened By Birchway Leasing office.. The Agents in that office suck I've never experienced this before and I stayed in a hotel in Carmel Indiana for 3Years before moving clear down here...Like They Are Sad Leasing Agents especially the community manager Kristen Bradshaw..She told me to Goggle the corporate phone number lol smh wow
Great Doctors and inexpensive vet services
Great Treatment / Service, the Staff is Awesome !

My cat was refusing to eat and they quickly figured out what my cat needed, treated it and now he is back to eating as normal! Definitely recommend taking your furry companions here. Inexpensive and amazing service ❤️❤️ front lady was amazing, the person who assisted us was amazing and the doctor was amazing as well!
Veterinarian is great, vet techs are kind, but reception is horrendous. Horrible etiquette for a low skill job.

I took my 10-month-old puppy to the vet; I didn't have an appointment and had to wait 1 hour and 50 minutes, but I swear it was worth it. My puppy had been diagnosed with severe seizures. Unfortunately, it was a holiday when he started having them, and no one could see him, and emergency clinics are incredibly expensive! Just for the initial visit, they wanted $200 😥. Plus tests, medication, etc. I couldn't believe that many people in the comments said they were given payment plans to pay the rest; that shouldn't be ethical. Anyway, I paid $278 here, and they did a blood test to rule out any internal damage, which is wonderful, as is the consultation and the medication. But listen! I decided to get the blood test! Otherwise, it would have only been $78. Honestly, it was worth it! My dog ​​couldn't even stand up, and with the first dose, he improved a lot! They gave me so much hope that my baby will recover, since he'll be under treatment. My puppy is already eating and drinking again. Something I didn't want to do anymore. The doctor was very kind to my dog; he had a seizure right then and the doctor rushed to help him 🥺🥹 Take your babies here! Negative comments are just from annoying people. 🤣
took my dog coco in here for the very first time I hope my dog feels better with his med. very great prices, Gaby was such a nice person that helped me during his visit thank you!
They are so caring and compassionate with the sick pets and the people.
Always low cost
The medical care is excellent, but the customer service is terrible; they are very rude.
Both of my babies are in good hands here at this place
Great service!!!!!

This is first time have a very very bad experience starting with front desk lady and then the assistant nurse bad attitude . Never never come back with my puppy ..the service was for my little puppy checkup normal follow up
I finally found a affordable veterinary. They did what I wanted and didn't try to push unnecessary stuff on me .

Very nice staff and super patient my pup, Bailey!!! Easy to find but can be a bit busy early in the mornings as everyone tries to be "first" in line. Make and keep your appointments--it definitely speeds things up!! Also, there's a sister clinic across the street less than a quarter-mile away with the same pricing and policies...but a different name?? The parking lot has looked super empty over there the few times that I've passed it while North Line has been packed, they're missing a ton of opportunity by not branding them in the same fashion---that's my ONLY criticism!! Highly recommend!!! 🖤🖤
Hard to get inside for appointments and never any doctors

Terrible service. They are not professional at all. They open at 8 a.m., and I was the first person waiting outside, yet they kept me waiting until 10 a.m. When I asked if it would take much longer, they told me there was no doctor and that he wouldn’t arrive until after 12 p.m. They play with people’s time and with the health of pets.

Obviously, I got upset and complained to a nurse, and she got angry, telling me she wasn’t a witch to know whether the doctor would show up or not. If you want to save time, don’t come here—terrible service, I do not recommend it. Also, they open at 8 but don’t start attending patients until 9, and that’s only if the doctor feels like arriving on time.

I love the service they offer there; from the receptionist to the technicians and the doctor, they are all excellent. I like that they listen to you, answer your questions, and treat your pets with so much love.
Walk in welcome

I took my kitten to this clinic with an intestinal obstruction that required emergency surgery, and they said they couldn't see him at that moment and that I should go to "My Vet Pet," which is owned by the same person and is the same thing. What a disappointment and lack of humanity I encountered! Before they were truly concerned about the health and well-being of your pet, they wanted to sell you as many of their products as possible. They took x-rays of my cat and immediately tried to sell me flea treatment, food, vaccines, etc., completely ignoring the seriousness of my cat's condition. At no point did the doctor explain to me the seriousness of an intestinal obstruction. They injected my cat and gave him fluids, which I doubt they actually administered. Because I had to rush my cat to the emergency room that night due to dehydration and the severity of his condition. And there, the veterinarian asked me: "Didn't they explain the seriousness of this situation to you?" Of course not! A total lack of humanity; it's just a circus to sell as much as they can.

Best prices in all of Houston!
Not only is this the most affordable vet around but they really do care about all the animals they see! Would recommend them to anyone with pets! Make sure to call ahead to make an appointment, usually long walk in times.

I absolutely loved this place! I took my 6-year-old Chihuahua there and they treated her wonderfully. She got much better. The staff were very understanding and the place is inexpensive. I highly recommend it! ❤️
He is the best veterinarian I have been able to find around Houston.
They took care of cats and dogs that in other vets were not effective and way expensive
Reasonable prices. You can tell they care about the pets.

Our cat unfortunately passed on the day her usual vet was closed, so we went to this sister clinic- and had a terrible experience. Long wait outside with a deceased pet in my arms, no sort of empathy from receptionists, and it just felt so cold and rushed. The receptionist called to bluntly tell us her ashes were back, so we quickly go to bring her home, only to find the vet/assistant had put MY NAME as the deceased so I now have a certificate of MY cremation. It leaves me with very little faith that our pet was actually cremated properly with her favorite toy. A devastating experience somehow made worse by this place. Very impersonal and inexperienced staff. Even cheap prices can't make up for that.

I highly recommend this vet clinic! Everything is very reasonably priced and they truly care about your pet! Wait times can be long but they get you seen as quick as possible! I took my chihuahua here for a teeth cleaning, he really only likes me and can be grumpy with other people, they did wonderful with him and kept me updated about him.

We went for the first time and they treated us very well. We thought our kitten wasn't going to survive, but she's been much better for the last three days. They performed surgery on her, and my children came back because they were worried. They were treated very well, and the doctor answered all their questions. We would definitely go back.

Hate to even put a one star ! They are horrible took dog . my baby went in perfect condition and got spayed and tumor remove on Dec . 03, 2025 . And , she been down since then gave me a diagnosis that exhausted after taking her for another opinion and then had to take to ER ! And all this sickness came from there care Northline low cost pet clinic not caring for her correctly.

Carol is AMAZING! She cares for your pet as if it were her own and goes the extra mile to provide peace of mind while you leave your pet for a lengthy procedure. My dog received care for a tumor removal on his leg and vet and staff were great to provide assistance. Glad I came across this facility! I was charged a fraction of the cost that I was getting quoted elsewhere. Thank you Affordable pet clinic!
Very good clinic and the nurses were very friendly, especially a 19-year-old boy whose name I don't know, and the doctor who treated me was very good.
This is really an affordable pet clinic. For the price and cares they have is unbelievable.  It's a busy place so be patient expect to wait a long time at the location.

Unprofessional “Doctor” and “assistants” if you don’t have the money there’s other affordable vets. I advise you to look for another place even if you find one that’s pricy. I personally will never go here again.

This clinic is AWFUL.
Instead of “low-cost,” it should be labeled “low quality.”

I have been here twice, and both times I had to beg for an actual exam. Even then, the exams were rushed and incomplete. You can call ahead, be spoken to rudely by the receptionist, be told to come in—only to still wait over two hours once you arrive.

The front desk staff had no clear understanding of what services the clinic even offers, and the technicians demonstrated a concerning lack of basic medical knowledge.

The most disturbing part was watching my dog shake and cry in pain while the clinic continued seeing routine annual visits instead of addressing urgent cases. There is NO triage system whatsoever. If your pet has any sense of urgency, do NOT come here.

The doctors were insensitive, unprofessional, and had terrible bedside manner. As a veterinary technician myself, I can confidently say this is some of the WORST medicine I’ve witnessed. I would never trust this clinic with my animals again.

Yes, the prices are cheap—but you don’t even get what you pay for.

To make matters worse, the clinic itself is in horrible condition: dirty floors, run-down, and severely outdated. It does not feel clean, safe, or professionally maintained.

I STRONGLY urge pet owners to look elsewhere.
I discovered this place today and it's amazing! They treated my 16-year-old dog with so much love. Thank you so much for all the love you put into your work 🫶🏻❤️❤️
Best vet, best prices. The wait is long but the care is 5 star

They have always done a good job for my animals and I recently rescue a little puppy what she had worms and she is doing really great I just love her to death she loves to ride in my lap she loves her big step sister the boxer still getting used to her.
It's been 7 years I guess since I posted this, I no longer have the boxer she want the dog Heaven 😢 let the services at the pet clinic on not too expensive I took my black dog there which is in the picture and she's seven now and I got her 3-year shots for only $70, so if you would like to save money this is the place to go to. This is the puppy now she is really grown.
Thank you for helping me with my kittens
Fast service. Little to no wait. Budget friendly

I’ve been coming here for more than 5 years now & have never had a bad experience. My dog isn’t the friendliest and I love that the doctor and vet assistants never get scared or are rude about her temper. They always welcome & treat her with a big smile on their face! Today my vet assistant was Katherine and she was super friendly and sweet! Also, their prices are great.
The entire staff is so loving, kind, patient and thorough with my pets!

Charged and arm and a leg and didn't properly diagnose what was wrong with my cat. All they said was that my cat had scabies but clearly they missed something. Because I woke up this morning to A DEAD CAT. I called and politely tried to talk to a vet and all the help they offered was they said they'll call back later. Don't go here unless you want sub par services for your pet.

*Edit: they never called me back to discuss why my cat died. Absolutely heartless. I wish I could give zero stars and get that $120 back that I spent

My experience at this clinic is outstanding l!!! The doctor is very caring,and knowlegable. so is his staff. Sabrina my dog has been coming here for a few years.Make a appointment or walk in,but walk in is about 1hour or so
Great thing

I went in as a walkin. The vet tech was just awesome. I wish I would have gotten her name, but she's the one in the knee brace. She was just so kind and understanding. The vet was nice, but it felt like he was very rushed to get from one animal to the next. I had asked about a skin condition & I don't believe he truly addressed it. While the cost of the office visit is cheap, I really wish bloodwork wasn't $200. I was already paying $100 for the visit & meds, and the vet made me feel worse than I already do about not being able to afford bloodwork; it was the vet tech that made me feel better about my situation. The girls that check you in/out were very nice also. One thing I would recommend is a couple more seats in the waiting area. I know a lot of people waited in their cars, but if someone doesn't have that option, having a place to sit would be lovely.

Amazing customer care
💯% Recommended …
I brought my kitten Chip in for her spay. Everything went smoothly and she healed up great! Thanks to the team!
Took my dog Rico today, we loved it, everyone was so nice and the Doctor was great too! Recommend them to everyone!

I arrived here today and I understood my dogs was in a bad condition. I have a bandage on his tail where the injury occurred. They didn’t even take the bandage off!!! They just said put to sleep. They don’t care he didn’t give me any options. I won’t be using this vet EVER AGAIN!!!

The staff was very polite and nice. I walked in and honestly didn't have to wait long. I was instructed to wait on my car and that I will be called, which for me was convenient, that way my cat wouldn't get stressed being around other pets on top of the stress of being at the vet. They took care of our cat,  were patient and caring. And the prices are very fair as well. I will definitely will be coming back for our pet needs and recommending this place!!
This place is good place to take your dog and they can accept walk in 🩷
Took care of us with a friendly and respectful staff.

Girls in the front don’t know how to do their job I wasted my time driving all the way out here just for them to say my appointment wasn’t until next Thursday
Stressed my cat out for nothing
The employees here are wonderful with animals and the cost was very reasonable.

Always great with a very beautiful staff ❤️ so I never mind waiting. It's hard to tell if I'm at the Vet or the Next top model competition 🤔 either way the staff is lovely 😍 inside and out always have a smile no matter how exhausted they're 😊 I come 2hrs away and my female German shepherds love coming here ❤️ because they think they're divas anyway. 👍 👌 👍
They charge to much for meds.and other services.  Like to have minor surgery on my small dog .1000 that is way to much.
Best in Houston

Came here because my cat would go to the litter box but wouldn’t urinate or urinate a small amount. Vet said my cats bladder was completely empty so no obstruction and he did bloodwork for $175 and everything came out good so we ruled it as him being stressed. He gave me antibiotics and medication and my total was around $240. I think $240 is a good price because I know another vet would’ve charged me an insane amount just to tell me my cats stressed.
Bad service waited 3hr for nothing we were walk ins lady said 1hr wait

I was placed on hold for 15 minutes. When I asked if she had forgotten me, she laughed and said no. They are just busy. Who does this? Very unprofessional. Thank God to all of you who had a good experience, because I hung up before I sinned in my words. God bless you, young; I pray you learn better skills.
I bring my pets here because it’s affordable and the techs and vet  are great people. They really care.

Nice enough staff, a little bit of an attitude though. In tough times where owners are having pet issues, the staff should be able to handle the stress better. They directed me to a sister location, so I do appreciate that.

I brought my dog in for a routine surgery that they say they do all the time and they did the surgery, but when they put her in recovery, no one monitors your dog and they never checked on her to see if she was OK and five hours later they call me and tell me she has passed away. Don’t use this place for any kind of surgery. They may be OK for shots or routine checkups but that’s about as far as it should go if you love your animal, don’t let them do any kind of surgery or you may end up with a dead animal. if I can give them zero stars, I would. The staff was too busy, taking care of the new money coming in the door to be concerned about my pet.

We carried our lovely lady in to check to find out why she was lethargic.  The Dr.told us she needed immediate surgery.   He called us back about 5 hours later to say she died in recovery!!  What the heck was everybody doing that they wasn't monitoring her.  So just like that she's dead.  Never ever take your pets here because evidently "care" here is not important!!!

Today was my second visit here and
the entire staff is very sweet. I had an appointment for 11:20 and they were accurate on getting me in for my appointment time! I took my dachshund Phoebe and one of the vet techs Lillie had was so kind and did a great job at making Phoebe as comfortable as she could be, before she had to get her rabies& parvo vaccinations.  Great experience
Excellent
Excellent customer service highly recommended vets very friendly and quick service

Never again! I went 2 times to this place and got turned away both times. Saturdays are horrible, no parking and line wrapped around building. I went during the week and guess what, they take last pet at 4. They close at 5:30. They did not inform me of this. Will never be back.

I arrived without an appointment and they saw me. It was recommended to me, and I left very satisfied. They were very kind and treated my cat quickly for a mouth infection. Now I'll take my other pets there. Highly recommended, and the prices are very affordable.
Everyone is very nice and my Dolly was taken care of right away for her dental.

Everyone very friendly and helpful. Our regular vet was off for surgery day. Googled and found immediate help at this location. Called to other pet hospitals and pet ERs. Nobody cared or wanted to help...and that was on a Wed. 9am. Dr. Reddi was great, professional, and cared for our pet. Only downfall is we live further away, in Tomball.

Come to this clinic for heartworm or flea/tick meds or BASIC care.  When it comes to diseases, even routine bloodwork, I’d suggest looking elsewhere.  After wasting an afternoon (over 90 minutes for a renal panel) — I got the incorrect panel even after mentioning I wanted to compare Creatinine and BUN from a previous panel.  The doctor basically is not thorough and does not communicate effectively (telling me the SDMA was enough to show her condition had worsened when in fact it does not show the complete picture — also, it’s normal to have fluctuations +/- 5.  On top of that, the “techs” have given false information or information that is outside of their wheelhouse (suggesting for her to be given Pedialyte — or meds with cream cheese) — both of which are not suggested for dogs with renal issues. Today, they stuck my dog 6-7 times using the needle like a yo-yo to draw blood.  After the 3rd time, I had to advocate for my dog and request for someone else yet they defaulted to the best excuse they could find “she has small veins” (45 lb boxer/pit mix).  I made the mistake of coming here after going to Sugar Land Veterinary Specialist to get follow up panels as it’s simple enough — but my dog deserves better than this.  Also, the antibiotics she’s on can be refilled at CVS (as the specialist called in to reduce the cost) — Tidwell would not do the same so I had to get the refill from their pharmacy for 3x the price.
We've been taking our dogs there for years, great vet Dr and his staff is very good and friendly.
Great service and good prices!
Excellent service, and knowledgeable. Decent prices $25 for visit
Amazing vet care! My Georgie was sick after eating a jalapeño and the doctors and nurses did a great job providing the treatment at a very affordable price! We even got him micro chipped!!

I rarely leave negative reviews, but I feel it’s important to share my experience so other pet owners can make an informed decision. I reached out to Tidwell Affordable Pet Clinic on a Monday, hoping to get help for my pet who was in pain. I initially spoke with someone at the front desk, but unfortunately, the professionalism and communication were seriously lacking.

All week, I had to repeatedly call just to get an update, and no one followed up with me as promised. I was constantly told someone would call me back, but that never happened. When I finally got to speak with the doctor on Friday, he was rude, dismissive, and lacked any compassion. He sounded like an Indian man (just to help identify who I spoke with). Instead of helping, he passed me off to someone else and claimed there was nothing they could do — after taking my money.

It’s clear that this clinic prioritizes profit over care. The front desk is unprofessional and untrained when it comes to relaying important information or managing urgent cases. If your pet is in pain and you want real help, I strongly advise going elsewhere — even if it costs more. Sometimes affordability comes at a price, and unfortunately, that price was my pet’s comfort and my peace of mind.

Horrible experience first when I was being led to the back to the consultation room the girls that work here didn’t even bother to move or make space for me to go through, they were all in the hallway on their phones. Once in the consultation area, I noticed it was so dirty. Then the doctor came in and he didn’t even wanna open my pet’s mouth to check on him and he immediately wanted to put him to sleep and “try“to get the bad tooth out. Only when I mentioned another doctor was able to open his mouth until then he did the effort to actually look. I immediately just took him out go to an actual vet and I left.

On a side note. I understand he’s not from this country, but I could not understand a word he was saying, and he was very cold and rude. To be a vet and be acting like that I do not know how people trust him with their animals.

I do not recommend this clinic under any circumstances. While the low-cost pricing may seem like a good option, the experience I had here was devastating—and I feel it’s important to share, especially for anyone trying to help vulnerable animals.

I brought in two stray puppies for a check-up. Both tested negative for Parvo and were going to be treated for worms. One of the puppies was given “fluids” and a shot for nausea, which I was told was free of charge. However, nothing about this treatment was included in my billing or medical records. That lack of documentation raised immediate concerns—because it meant they could have administered anything without my informed consent.

Less than 30 minutes after leaving the clinic, the puppy who received the “fluids” and injection passed away. In shock and grief, I contacted the clinic. I was told I could come in to speak privately with Dr. Challa and a vet assistant. But when I arrived, I was met by the entire staff in the front lobby while still holding the lifeless puppy in my arms. There was no privacy, no comfort, and no empathy. I simply wanted to understand what treatment had been administered. Instead, I was met with hostility.

When I asked for answers, the staff became defensive and accusatory. A staff member looked me in the eyes and said, “you came to a low-cost clinic because you can’t afford better care,” as if that excused what had happened. That statement was not only cruel—it was demeaning, and suggested that because I sought affordable care, the life of the puppy somehow mattered less.
When I brought up the idea of filing a complaint or leaving a review, Dr. Challa told me not to post anything online and warned that he would begin “building a case” against me. Then, a vet assistant followed me outside, took a photo of my license plate, and said they would contact the authorities if I pursued any formal complaint. I was left feeling not only heartbroken and blamed—but actively threatened and silenced.

Because of the intimidation I experienced, I later spoke with a local police officer for guidance. He was far more compassionate and understanding than anyone at the clinic. He reassured me that I had done nothing wrong, that my concerns were valid, and that I had every right to file a formal complaint. His support provided more comfort and clarity than the entire clinic staff combined. I had only had the puppy for two days and was doing what I believed was the responsible and humane thing by getting medical attention. Instead, I was blamed for the death, denied information, and then intimidated for speaking up.

After reading other reviews, I realized my experience wasn’t unique. Others have shared similar concerns about this clinic’s lack of professionalism, compassion, and accountability. If you care about your pet, please go somewhere else. Even if it means paying more, it’s worth it for peace of mind, ethical care, and respectful treatment. No one deserves to be yelled at, threatened, or made to feel at fault—especially not while trying to save a life.

Dr. Challa and all the staff at North Line Low Cost Veterinary Clinic are to be blamed for the imminent death of my family’s dog, Jackson.

Due to his age, recently my family noticed issues with his mobility and him being lethargic. He had visible congestion of the nose and eyes and because of his ailments, was not eating regularly over the past month so he was underweight and dehydrated. He also had several lipomas (non-cancerous masses) on him that have formed over the span of years, with the largest one drooping from his abdomen. Many veterinarians, clinics and pet hospitals told us that surgery would be needed to remove it but he would still be okay. They all told us to just continuously monitor it.

On June 4th, 2025, my mother decided to take him to North Line Low Cost Veterinary Clinic, as she was recommended by his normal vet due to the high costs for bloodwork, surgery, treatment, etc. My mother arrived around 9 AM, shortly after, they were seen by a Practicing Nurse, Nurse, and Dr. Challa. Without introductions, formalities or even a pleasant demeanor, Dr. Challa comes in and immediately tells my mother that we should euthanize Jackson. To this my mother becomes upset, lets the family know and asks Dr. Challa for alternatives. He says that they will do some bloodwork but the surgery for his Lipoma would have a 70-80% chance of survival as Jackson was underweight and dehydrated. The bloodwork came back and only showed mild symptoms that could have been treated with prescribed medication. After my mother’s suggestion to get Jackson’s weight and hydration up before surgery, Dr. Challa allows for her to purchase the prescriptions that addressed those issues as well as a skin infection he had.

They offered Jackson an IV bag of fluid for dehydration and when my mother asked if she could take a picture, they told her that she could not. So they proceed to pump Jackson with a liquid that is unknown to my mother. While they are pumping him full of the liquid, my mom went up front to pay the bill. By the time my mother came back to get Jackson, he was already dying if not dead. His face was pale, he was trembling, and his tongue was hanging out of his mouth, a condition we had never seen him like before. With concern, while picking up Jackson, my mother asks the nurse why he looked so different and they chastised her saying that he came in lethargic like that. Without an ounce of compassion or empathy, they escorted Jackson and my mother out the side door (not even the curtesy of walking her through the front) and sent her on her way. By the time they made it to the car, Jackson had died. My mother jumped out of the car, screaming and shouting. After a few minutes the doctor and the nurse came out yelling at HER telling her not to shout and yell at them! She told them not to chastise her and to check on Jackson, of whom they pronounced dead. After the doctor tried to offer an excuse as to what happened, they left her in the parking lot with Jackson in the backseat. No guidance, nothing, just sent her on her way.

Our main issue with North Line Low Cost Veterinary Clinic is their lack of compassion and support for our family during this time. They were disgustingly rude to my mother and whether it was the fluids they gave Jackson, their lack of attentiveness and aid or simply the negative energy surrounding that building, they, without a doubt contributed to Jackson’s death. They took this away from us. We know Jackson was older in age and if that WAS his day to pass, it should have been in the comfort of our home, loved and protected, not some money grabbing clinic, chastised and diminished.

To Dr. Challa and all the staff at North Line Low Cost Veterinary Clinic, do not worry, the lord will have his way with all of you for the way my family was mistreated.
